model_configuration: Inherited parent assistant configuration; no model or reasoning overrides were specified. Immutable snapshot and sampling settings were not exposed.
author_model_relationship: Same assistant system as artifact author; fresh contexts do not make this an independent evaluation.
batch_context: Four fresh primary-text contexts with seventeen episodes each; two fresh matched-text and two fresh image contexts with six episodes each. Episodes within a batch share context.
permitted_tool_access: Read named input batch, optionally in segments
View named PNGs for image condition, including repeat views after display issues
Write one literal model response via apply_patch
tool_activity_evidence: Worker self-reports; complete tool/transport traces were not independently audited.
scored_outputs: Structured claim labels only; free-text reasons/evidence paths retained but not independently adjudicated.
live_inference_reproducibility: Exact rerun cannot be guaranteed without an exposed immutable model snapshot and sampling configuration. Archived inputs, outputs and scoring are reproducible offline.

model_identity_provenance.note: Identity correction only; no new model inference or response revision.
